from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
im=np.array(Image.open('observations/obs_0178.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
for u in [445,460,470,480,495]:
    prev=None; out=[]
    for v in range(280,430):
        t=tuple(im[v,u]//14)
        if t!=prev: out.append('%d:(%d,%d,%d)'%(v,im[v,u][0],im[v,u][1],im[v,u][2])); prev=t
    print('u%3d'%u,' '.join(out[:9]))
" 2>/dev/null
